title: SlipX actuator and electrical limits
description:
limits.yaml: what the car cannot exceed, and the actuator hardware fitted. Kept separate from dynamics.yaml because these are a property of the hardware, and swapping a servo, an ESC or a battery changes this file and nothing else.

The steering, esc and electrical blocks are consumed from L2 (CORE-08 to CORE-10); below that the drivetrain block is the whole actuator model. Every block is optional at the schema level because a migration cannot invent values; a tier that needs an absent field refuses by name rather than defaulting (ADR-0030).

max_angle.description: Road wheel travel, symmetric, as a positive magnitude. [rad] Not a servo pulse width and not degrees. Consumed from L0.

max_rate.description: Servo slew rate limit. [rad/s] Consumed from L2 (CORE-10). Identifiable by commanding a step and timing the response.

bandwidth.description: Second-order servo natural frequency. [rad/s] Consumed from L2 (CORE-10).

damping.description: Second-order servo damping ratio. [-] Consumed from L2.

accel_max.description: Peak forward acceleration the drivetrain can deliver. [m/s^2] At L0 and L1 this is the whole drivetrain model; from L2 it is superseded by the ESC torque-speed curve and becomes a bound rather than the mechanism.

decel_max.description: Peak braking deceleration, as a positive magnitude. [m/s^2] Brake bias deliberately does not appear: a 1/10 car brakes through the motor, and a brake bias field would be a parameter nobody can set (CORE-08).

esc.description: The ESC and motor torque-speed curve (CORE-08), stated at the WHEELS and at pack_nominal_v so that no gear ratio or motor constant is a parameter. Both curve numbers scale linearly with actual pack voltage in the model. Identifiable from one full-throttle straight-line run: the force-speed line gives torque_stall and omega_free, its low-speed plateau is the current limit, and ESC telemetry gives the amperes alongside (ADR-0030).

torque_stall.description: Total drive torque at the wheels at zero wheel speed, full throttle, at pack_nominal_v, BEFORE the current limit: the zero-speed intercept of the measured force-speed line, times the wheel radius. [N m]

omega_free.description: Wheel speed at which drive torque reaches zero, at pack_nominal_v. [rad/s]

torque_per_amp.description: Wheel torque per ampere of motor current. [N m/A] What turns current_max and regen_current_max into torque caps the physics can apply.

efficiency.description: Mechanical power at the wheels over electrical power at the battery terminals, for the battery current draw. [-]

electrical.description: Consumed from L2 (CORE-08, CORE-09). Battery sag is what makes the last lap slower than the first, and a car tuned without it is tuned for a battery state that lasts thirty seconds.

pack_nominal_v.description: Nominal pack voltage. [V] 11.1 for a 3S lithium polymer.

pack_v_full.description: Open-circuit voltage at state of charge 1. [V] 12.6 for a 3S lithium polymer.

pack_v_empty.description: Open-circuit voltage at state of charge 0, the floor the pack must not be discharged below. [V] About 9.9 for a 3S lithium polymer.

pack_internal_resistance.description: Internal resistance, which is what produces sag under load. [ohm]

regen_current_max.description: Regenerative braking current limit, its own limit and usually well below current_max. [A]
